title: Zapata y Villa
goal: Read about Zapata's land-focused Plan de Ayala in the south, Villa's northern División del Norte, and their brief, ultimately fragile 1914 alliance.

items: Explain what caused the break between Madero and Zapata.
State what the Plan de Ayala demanded.
Describe how Villa's revolutionary army differed from Zapata's.
Explain what Zapata and Villa did together in 1914, and why it didn't last.
